[[File:Spy_Family_vol_1_2_3_4.png|thumb|500px|Cover of the first 4 Japanese tankōbon volumes, featuring the [[List of Spy × Family characters#Forger family|Forger family members]].]]
''[[Spy × Family]]'' is a Japanese [[manga]] series written and illustrated by [[Tatsuya Endo]]. The series began serialization on the manga website ''[[Shōnen Jump+]]'' on March 25, 2019. Its individual chapters have been collected in 17 {{Transliteration|ja|[[tankōbon]]}} volumes, with the first having been released on July 4, 2019. The series is licensed for English-language release in North America by [[Viz Media]], who published the first volume on June 2, 2020. As the series is published in Japan, it is also released simultaneously in English digitally on Viz Media's website.

The covers of the tankōbon features a main character resting on a designer's chair, surrounded by item(s) or characteristics that represent the character, their life and their personalities.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Here Are All The Designer Chairs Featured In Spy×Family So Far |url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/feature/2022-04-27/here-are-all-the-designer-chairs-featured-in-spy-family-so-far/.183892 |access-date=2022-05-24 |website=[[Anime News Network]] |language=en |archive-date=October 5, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231005231349/https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/feature/2022-04-27/here-are-all-the-designer-chairs-featured-in-spy-family-so-far/.183892 |url-status=live}}</ref> The real life chairs were chosen by the author as he deemed fit with the character's personalities.<ref>{{Cite tweet |author=Tatsuya Endo |author-link=Tatsuya Endo |user=_tatsuyaendo_ |number=1395942061581369348 |date=May 22, 2021 |access-date=August 29, 2022|language=Japanese |script-title=ja:今更ですが7巻書影が出てたので。|trans-title=It'd been a while, but finally volume 7 was released. }}</ref> For volume 10, Endo decides to forgo the inclusion of the designer chair motif to make the cover befit the volume's story.<ref name="vol10_chair">{{Cite tweet |author=Tatsuya Endo |author-link=Tatsuya Endo |user=_tatsuyaendo_ |number=1571694469707337729 |date=Sep 19, 2022 |access-date=Sep 30, 2022|language=Japanese |script-title=ja:あと10巻書影が出てたみたいです。|trans-title=It seems that we published 10 volumes. }}</ref>

<!--Uncollected chapter summaries:
Research: The Forger family visits London.
128: Yor asks Loid out on another date, after her boss at City Hall gives her tickets to attend a taping of ''Five-Year Love Plan'', a popular television drama. Both Hemlock and Yuri overreact, and Yuri finds a way to join them. An armed group hijacks the broadcast to announce their grievances.
129: Loid, Yor, and Yuri are unable to fight back, imagining the catastrophes that would follow if they revealed their identities. As the hijackers' demands are met and more hostages arrive, the ringleader reveals their intent: to re-shoot the ending of ''Five-Year Love Plan''.
130: The ringleader explains the ''Five-Love'' ending was changed at the last minute, ruining the series. As they proceed through reshooting the scenes, Loid becomes a set designer to avoid being filmed as an extra, Yuri acts as a director's assistant, and Yor literally acts to stand in for an absent actress; her role expands after her anxiety serves to highlight the character's awkwardness. Yuri panics when he sees the script call for someone to kiss her.
131: Loid coolly devises a plan and apparatus to switch Yuri for Yor in the kissing scene, taking advantage of their family resemblances; despite the constant threat of death from the hijackers, Yuri's reactions and ad-libbing prove a hit with viewers. Yuri grudgingly bumps fists with Loid in celebration.
132: After airing their preferred ending, the hijackers surrender and the hostages are freed. Yor confesses that she feared for Loid's life; Loid says he was trying to protect her and wonders if his emotions are interfering with the mission. Becky and Anya arrive in an armored transport with Franky and Martha to drive them home. Both Yor and Loid realize how exhausting it is to playact a role.
133: Inspired by Yor's star turn, Becky drafts Anya into a scheme to get scouted by a talent agent on Lindon Street, but their efforts end in them being mistaken as terrorists.
134: With Anya playing with Becky and Yor working on the weekend, Loid is unexpectedly taken by Yuri to accompany him at a party filled with his State Security Service co-workers, who grill him to decide if he is a worthy husband to Yor; Loid panics between the anxiety of being surrounded by enemies and the potential to learn new information. When he learns Yor will be stopping by, his fears are heightened when he remembers he disguised himself as one of Yuri's co-workers, Chadwick Curtis, to confront Yor in the past, who is also present at the party.
135: S.S.S. Director Wyland Wilker shows up, poorly disguised as a pizza delivery man, leaving Loid frantic, even moreso when Yor arrives. She rejects his attempt to withdraw gracefully, having a new ambition to remain in control when close to him. Yuri starts falling apart at seeing their closeness and Yor complicates her efforts by drinking wine.
136: Loid desperately tries to sedate Yor with a tranquilizer which Franky built into his watch, as a polite excuse to disengage from the party, but her reflexes and constitution prove insurmountable. Yuri collapses upon witnessing Yor cuddling with Loid and Wilker's stubborn refusal to leave panics both Loid and Wilker's staff, leading to desperate measures which ultimately succeed. Loid faints shortly after returning home.
137: Loid recuperates at the hospital under Fiona's watchful eyes; when Anya and Yor visit, the girl learns Fiona's motives, who she calls "hard-no mama", through her psychic powers. Trying to placate her, Fiona feeds Anya sweets, but the girl stubbornly trails her through the hospital. Fiona learns from Director Gorey that former Director Surjay will attend the neuroscience conference, and finds Surjay's classic [[Tatra 603|T-603]] in the garage, where she spots Donovan Desmond himself.
> 138: At Eden, Becky sighs over her Loid being hospitalized, reminding Damian that his father has been going to the hospital more often recently. Fiona sends a message to Loid alerting him to Donovan's presence and watches him proceed to the hospital's neurosurgery ward. Anya catches up to Fiona and learns her plans to pursue Donovan; she vows to help her succeed, fearing that Fiona's thoughts could be read if she gets too close to Donovan.
> 139.1: Fiona learns that Donovan is visiting the dying former Prime Minister Chapman, who had started the war between Ostalis and Westalis. Anya tries to slip past Donovan's fearsomely competent security; after failing, she goes to the next floor up and tries to listen to their minds, causing an electric reaction ...
> 139.2: ... as she searches for Donovan's thoughts. When she finds them, she is disappointed to learn that he is not, as claimed, able to read minds, and is not an alien. Donovan reflects on how Chapman's family refuses to visit him. Yor arrives to retrieve Anya and bring her to school, with a small delay as Anya's psychic power-induced nosebleed is treated. Fiona manages to evade detection, having learned very little from her eavesdropping on the conversation in Chapman's room. Back at Eden, Anya draws Damian's ire and walks away, saying that aliens do not exist, further inflaming Ewen and Emile. That night, she asks to sleep with Yor as the fragmented thoughts she overheard keep running through her mind.
> 140: Loid returns to his secret work, where Handler cautions the band of spies from acting on their natural biases and assumptions. At Eden, Anya and her class identify plants on the school grounds; seeking a plant that will treat Loid's tummy troubles, she finds common ground with Damian and his frequently absent father, and together, they retrieve one plant after considerable effort. After returning home, she learns Yor had the same idea, taking a day trip to the southern part of Ostania to obtain a large bouquet of herbs. The family "enjoys" the bitter tea together; Loid is touched by their concern, but his plans for a restful night are thwarted by Yor's dire cooking.
> 140.1: At the dog park, Anya and Becky compare Bond and Wiesel, their pets; Anya reveals that Bond is skinny underneath his fluff and resembles Mr. Henderson when wet, prompting Martha to suggest ways to accidentally soak him. Wiesel, Becky's aristocratic [[Lhasa Apso]], initially dismisses Bond as a peasant dog but finds his food delicious and when he curls around her, his coat keeps her warm, and by the time they decide to go home, Anya reveals that Wiesel may want to live with Bond, which Becky dismisses.
> 141: Damian makes an effort to reconnect with his apparently emotionless older brother Demetrius by asking him to go on a shopping trip together to purchase a birthday present for their father. Demitrius's robotic demeanor infuriates Damian, but they manage to bond over shared memories.
